hook: This gun fires with no gunpowder at all.
narration: This gun fires with no gunpowder at all.
It's the Navy's electromagnetic railgun, at Dahlgren, Virginia.
Instead of an explosion, a massive pulse of electricity launches the projectile.
It leaves at more than six times the speed of sound, and can reach over a hundred nautical miles.
In November 2016, the crew fired the first shot on a brand new range.
At the muzzle, the air burst into fire.
outcome: The railgun fired its first shot down the new range, and the projectile flew clear of the barrel.

location_card.place: Naval Surface Warfare Center Dahlgren, Virginia

title: Navy railgun fires with no gunpowder
description:
On Nov. 17, 2016, the Office of Naval Research and Naval Surface Warfare Center Dahlgren Division fired the first shot of the electromagnetic railgun at Dahlgren's new terminal range in Virginia.
